findings.message: [DQC.US.0081.9278] The line item concept us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt with a value of 60,000,000 and a calculation parent of us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActivities is represented as a sibling of us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermDebt with a value of 9,200,000 in the extension taxonomy role 006 - Statement - Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, but us-gaap:RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt is represented as a descendent of us-gaap:RepaymentsOfLongTermDebt in the calculation relationships defined in the US GAAP taxonomies. [DQC.US.0234.10930] The filing is missing a value for the concept TaxJurisdictionOfDomicileExtensibleEnumeration.  When reporting a tax reconcilation, with a value reported for the concept IncomeTaxReconciliationIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitAtFederalStatutoryIncomeTaxRate (with a value of 5,920,000), then a value for TaxJurisdictionOfDomicileExtensibleEnumeration must also be provided to indicate the domestic tax jurisdiction. - nath20260329_10k.htm 12951
